title: [Hinterwilds, Hoarbriar]
description: The broken point of an elk antler jabs out of the thorny thicket like a reproachful finger.  All around it, the brambles are trampled in a way that hints of struggle, the most cold-bitten among them having shattered like brittle glass.  A few beads of ruby red on the surviving vines suggest the altercation ended in a stalemate.
